'''Chelleya''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located within the [[Chelleya system/Legends|Chelleya system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

When the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders [[Nagai–Tof War|invaded]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] led a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Eriadu Authority]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] [[Interceptor/Legends|starfighters]] in [[Battle of Chelleya|repelling]] the invaders at Chelleya. Hublin's victory<ref name="EGtW" /> redirected the Nagai path of conquest away from the Authority's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Chelleya was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Chelleya [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Chelleya, in grid square M-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
